data.description:
## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/_store/hlc.py:35-41,60-66,137-156` still honors `REBAR_HLC=0`, although `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md:590-592` calls it a one-release rollback and many releases have since shipped. Disabling HLC can reintroduce causal ordering errors under skewed clocks.

## Approach

Remove the production disable branch, its environment registration, documentation, and tests. Retain legacy event reads and deterministic test-time clock injection, which are distinct compatibility and testability contracts.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_store/hlc.py`
- HLC environment/config registry and maintained documentation
- `tests/unit/test_hlc.py`

Cascade flag: true. Recensus environment parsing, dynamic reads, docs, fixtures, and monkeypatch consumers.

## Testing

Cover legacy event reduction/read compatibility and deterministic injected-clock ordering after the disable branch is gone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `REBAR_HLC=0` no longer disables HLC or appears in the live environment/config registry.
- [ ] Maintained documentation and tests for the expired rollback branch are removed.
- [ ] Legacy events remain readable and deterministic test-time clock injection remains available.
- [ ] HLC ordering tests, focused store tests, lint, and typecheck pass.
data.title: Retire the expired HLC rollback switch
